journal.title: First Trade Decisions — Juneteenth Run
journal.body: Market closed (Juneteenth). Alpaca paper API blocked by network egress. Ran full research cycle and identified 2 high-quality paper trades for June 22 open: (1) MU 23 shares @ $1,140 limit — pre-earnings play with HBM memory sold-out thesis, June 24 catalyst, $1,300-1,500 analyst targets, stock hit ATH +8% on June 18. (2) NVDA 128 shares @ $205 — long-term AI GPU thesis, Blackwell demand, 95% analyst buy consensus, $275 target. Both sized in NEUTRAL regime (VIX 16.4): 5.25% risk each. Combined cost $52,460, leaving 47.5% cash buffer. Paper trails SPY by -3.0% since inception due to zero positions. Action required: fix Alpaca egress (paper-api.alpaca.markets not in allowlist) and ALPACA_BASE_URL double-pathing bug.

strategy.name: Aggressive Momentum (Paper)
strategy.desc: Short-to-medium-hold momentum and breakout trades in high-beta large/mid-cap names and liquid sector ETFs. Rides relative strength with trailing stops; cuts losers fast. Aggressive sizing inside hard guardrails — paper only. QUALITY floor: price > $10, real revenue, liquid. No leveraged ETFs, no crypto.
rules: Enter on 2+ triggers: breakout, momentum leader, oversold snapback, near-term catalyst.
Size by risk: shares = (7% × equity) ÷ (entry − stop), capped at 30% of equity per name.
Trailing stop ~20% initial on every entry; tighten to 12-15% once +15% in profit.
Take partial profit at first target; let the remainder trail.
NEUTRAL regime (VIX 16-24): trim new sizes ~25%; be choosier.
No new entries if daily loss halt (−8%) is hit; stand down for the month at −25% MTD.
